newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo May dept store sales down 5.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo May dept store sales down 5.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Tokyo declined 5.9 percent in May from a year earlier to 182.7 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores Association said on Monday.
The survey covered 30 outlets of 14 companies, the association said.
"Sales were relatively active in the first half of the month but they did not grow in the second half as temperatures were unusually low for the month," the association said in a statement.
Purchases by individual consumers showed signs of recovery but purchases by corporations remained slow due to the reaction to a rush in demand in March ahead of the sales tax increase on April 1.
